_meta.integration: Append rules array to threshold_rules.json (skipping those already marked replaces_existing — remove the older version first)

rules.title: EUSAMA pre-test conditions gate
rules.conditions: tire_pressure_all_wheels_spec_ok = true, shock_absorbers_warmed_up = true, ambient_temp > 10, vehicle_load_within_spec = true
rules._action: Blocks EUSAMA-based downstream rules if preconditions fail

rules.title: ISO 8608 road class filter
rules._action: Enables emerging rules at class A-B (low noise floor). Blocks high-confidence diagnoses at class D+.

rules.title: Audio-accel time-lag validates suspension origin
rules._source: Physics: sound speed 340 m/s, suspension-to-cabin ≈ 2-3 m → 6-9 ms normal. Transmission ≈ 15-20 ms.
rules._action: Filter: excludes transmission/engine noise from suspension diagnostics

rules.title: Износ амортизатора — ранняя стадия (corrected thresholds)
rules._source: https://www.matec-conferences.org/articles/matecconf/pdf/2018/93/matecconf_bultrans2018_02005.pdf — baseline healthy az_std 0.05-0.15g, https://www.mdpi.com/2076-3417/14/1/127 — durability 500K km data

rules.title: Дисбаланс колёс — резонансный диапазон 80-120 km/h
rules.conditions: az_std z> 2, total_vibration > 3, speed between 80,120, vibration_freq_equals_wheel_rpm_1x = true
rules._replaces: wheel_imbalance (no upper speed bound, no freq check)

rules.title: Износ опор двигателя — order-detection (harmonics 1×/2×/3×/4× RPM)
rules._physics: Дефектная опора → engine firing harmonics проходят в кузов без damping. Match ≥3 harmonics filters out dynamic false-positives.

rules.title: Ступичный подшипник — BPFO через envelope spectrum
rules._requires: Bearing geometry from OEM spec (N, Bd, Pd, α) or SKF database

rules.title: Детонация двигателя — kurtosis + короткий impulse
rules._replaces: knock_detonation (без kurtosis — не различает от glaze squeal)
rules._physics: True knock = impulse <10ms + kurtosis >6. Glaze squeal = tonal continuous, kurtosis <3.

rules.title: Brake DTV развитый — peak at 120 km/h (900 rpm wheel)
rules.conditions: az_std z> 2, speed between 100,130, brake_applied = true
rules._complements: brake_vibration (20-80 km/h window) — новое правило ловит high-speed stage
rules._physics: DTV 20μm → pedal pulsation threshold. Peak transmitted at 900 rpm wheel = 120 km/h.

rules.title: Шаровая опора — ранний износ (AZ/AX ratio)
rules.conditions: vertical_lateral_ratio > 1.8, speed between 60,80, az_std < 0.5, iso8608_road_class <= B
rules._physics: Люфт шаровой → preferential vertical impulses (Z-axis). AX stays baseline, ratio grows above 1.8. Correlates с axial play ≥1.5 mm ДО pry-test detection.

rules.title: Шаровая — измеренный люфт превышает допуск
rules._requires: Manual input from dial indicator or pry test

rules.title: Износ сайлентблоков (полоса 120-180 Hz)
rules._source: https://www.matec-conferences.org/articles/matecconf/pdf/2018/93/matecconf_bultrans2018_02005.pdf — suspension vibration 50-200 Hz, эмпирический маркер 120-180 Hz
rules._brand_variations: VAG MQB: 120-180 Hz; Kia/Hyundai: 80-140 Hz (смещена); Toyota TNGA: baseline AZ/AX выше

rules.title: Ступичный подшипник — внутреннее кольцо (sidebands ±1× shaft)
rules._physics: Inner race дефект: 8-10 BPFI harmonics, каждая с sidebands ±1× shaft speed. Defining signature — outer race такого не даёт.

rules.title: Подшипник — Crest Factor alarm
rules._thresholds: baseline healthy 4.8 dB, damaged 11.4 dB, alarm midpoint 7 dB

rules.title: Адаптивный амортизатор — гидравлически мёртв БЕЗ electrical fault
rules._physics: Electrical self-diagnosis не ловит hydraulic wear (масло потеряло свойства, газ ушёл, клапан изношен). Катушка ещё работает, амортизатор уже нет.

rules.title: Brake Judder через BTV (без DTV)
rules._physics: BTV (Brake Torque Variation) — pad-disc friction coefficient нестабилен, slip-and-catch. Даёт judder без thickness variation.

rules.title: Опорный подшипник стойки — скрип при повороте
